Explore by area

Choose a region, a combined or mayoral authority, or a local authority, and see its schools’ Value Added v2.0 on a map and in a table.

Every state-funded mainstream secondary school in England has a Value Added v2.0 figure for all pupils, disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged pupils, girls and boys, 2021/22 to 2024/25: Attainment 8 points against England, shrunk by reliability. Choose a level and an area; the map zooms to its schools and the table lists them. Click a column heading to sort. “Absence against intake” is percentage points above (positive) or below what the school’s intake predicts.

Combined and mayoral authorities are from the ONS lookup of local authority districts to combined authorities (May 2025), with the six Devolution Priority Programme areas announced in February 2025 added and marked “(new)”. Areas not in a combined authority are not listed at that level. The full data are in va_v2_schools.csv, and the Sussex areas have pages of their own.

Adam Dennett · Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, UCL

 

Built from published DfE and Ofsted data. Nothing uses pupil-level records.
